name: Real-time 4DGS
definition: A method that achieves interactive frame rates by building a specialized renderer that fuses static background Gaussians with a small, fast-updating set of dynamic foreground Gaussians.
summary: Real-time 4DGS is the first method to treat time and space equally in Gaussian Splatting, achieving interactive frame rates by fusing static background Gaussians with a small, fast-updating set of dynamic foreground Gaussians.
